summary: Iter 82 — ROUJAUNE 4 new features confirmation (Milestone Progress Ring, Climb Detail Splits, Coach Milestone Shout-out, Streak Freeze). Backend: 5/5 pytest PASS. GET /api/analysis/milestones (demo) returns prev_rides=0, rides_progress in [0,1], prev_km, km_progress in [0,1] alongside existing totals/next. GET /api/analysis/climb-detail?id=climb-45.2-6.1108 (demo) returns splits array of exactly 4 items; each split has index (1..4), from_d, to_d (>from_d), times dict keyed by BOTH attempt activity_ids with numeric values, and a fastest activity_id that corresponds to the minimum of times. GET /api/analysis/streak returns a non-null dict (regression: duplicate stub removed) — freeze_tokens (int>=0), frozen_weeks (int>=0), can_freeze (bool), gap_week (non-empty string). POST /api/analysis/streak-freeze on demo returns 200 with {ok:false, reason:'nothing_to_freeze'} (no 500). GET /api/coach/milestone-note?coach_name=Alberto&coach_gender=male on demo returns 200 with {has_milestone:false} (no LLM call, no 500). Frontend @ 1024x1050 demo: /fitness shows Milestones card with a yellow progress ring displaying '8' + 'to 10' in the center (rides_progress=0.2 arc), Consistency Streak card shows '1 Streak Freeze banked'. /climb/climb-45.2-6.1108 shows Split times table with 4 rows (Split 1..4, distances 0.0-0.6 / 0.6-1.3 / 1.3-1.9 / 1.9-2.5 km); PB column cell highlighted yellow with ⚡ icon in every split (2:19, 2:38, 2:38, 2:38) vs #2 (2:57, 3:28, 3:29, 3:29). No red-screen or console errors on either screen.
